_doc: Demo hero places (IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md §1.2): a walkable loop around Queen's Park. These get the deep, reviewed material; everything else gets auto cards.

places.name: Ontario Legislative Building
places.why: the pink sandstone legislature at the centre of the park

places.name: Queen's Park
places.why: the park itself: statues, the old Taddle Creek ravine, how it got its name

places.name: Equestrian Statue of Edward VII
places.why: a statue that was moved here from Delhi

places.name: Canadian Volunteer Monument
places.why: the 1866 Fenian Raids monument in the park

places.name: Royal Ontario Museum
places.why: Crystal extension vs the 1914 heritage wings; nav landmark

places.name: Gardiner Museum
places.why: ceramics museum across from the ROM

places.name: Philosopher's Walk
places.why: the path that follows buried Taddle Creek

places.name: Taddle Creek
places.why: the lost river under the walk: thread for the whole tour

places.name: Hart House
places.why: Gothic Revival student centre; Massey family

places.name: Soldiers' Tower
places.why: WWI memorial carillon beside Hart House

places.name: University College
places.why: 1850s founding college; the ghost-story folklore

places.name: Convocation Hall
places.why: rotunda on King's College Circle

places.name: Simcoe Hall
places.why: UofT administration, faces the Circle

places.name: Louis B. Stewart Observatory
places.why: small observatory that was moved across campus

places.name: Knox College
places.why: Gothic college on the old observatory site

places.name: Wycliffe College
places.why: Anglican college at Hoskin & Queen's Park

places.name: Regis College
places.why: Jesuit college, home of the Homeless Jesus statue

places.name: Homeless Jesus
places.why: bronze bench sculpture with a story about its rejections

places.name: Victoria University
places.why: Victoria College, Romanesque, Northrop Frye

places.name: Annesley Hall
places.why: first women's residence in Canada

places.name: Lillian Massey Building
places.why: Massey family again; links to Hart House

places.name: St. Basil's Church
places.why: 1856 Gothic church on St. Joseph St

places.name: Trinity College
places.why: Tudor-Gothic college beside Philosopher's Walk

places.name: Massey College
places.why: 1963 Ron Thom modernist college; Robertson Davies

places.name: Medical Sciences Building
places.why: brutalist concrete; insulin-discovery connection
